prompt_text: Which title company in Fort Lauderdale FL is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” title company, but **Independence Title, Inc.** looks like a strong first choice based on the available information: it has a Fort Lauderdale office and a substantial set of positive reviews mentioning clear communication and handling both routine and complicated closings.

Other options worth comparing are **Independent Title of Fort Lauderdale** (reported 4.8/5 from 98 reviews) and **Summerland Title**. Review ratings can vary by site and may not reflect every client’s experience, so I’d ask each for a written estimate of title and closing fees, confirm who will handle your file, and check their availability and experience with your type of transaction.

In Florida, the buyer or seller may have a say in choosing the title company depending on the contract and local practice. Review your purchase agreement and ask your real-estate agent or attorney before committing.
